name: reset_entry
notes: Reset vector target. Stack=0x27ff, battery ADC check, RAM fill 0xbcdf, copies RAM code, RTC check, .data init, goto main

name: vec_break_stub
notes: reti only

name: fiq_handler
notes: INT_Status3 bit13 -> sub_08c9ef, then TimerF_Ctrl |= 0x8000 (Timer F; likely audio/ComAir timing)

name: irq0_stub
notes: reti only

name: irq1_handler
notes: INT_Status2 bit0: reads ASMICDAC_Data (0x79b4) into RAM 0x0d74 (microphone sample)

name: irq2_handler
notes: INT_Status1 bit0: sets flag RAM 0x0d95, acks

name: irq3_stub
notes: reti only

name: irq4_handler
notes: Timers A/B/C/D overflow (ctrl bit15) + SPU 0x7b85 bit14 -> sub_03b7b1 (sound service)

name: irq5_handler
notes: TFT/PPU: 0x7063 bit14 -> HB_Ctrl++ ; bit0 (frame) -> frame counter RAM 0x061e++

name: irq6_handler
notes: INT_Status2 bit7 = touch (CTS) -> sets flag; TimeBase C -> clock calibration via TimerH_UpCount; bit10 -> tick RAM 0x0606++

name: irq7_handler
notes: INT_Status2 bit1 -> sub_07daf7 (RTC alarm/second)

name: rtc_wait_ready
notes: polls RTC_Ready (0x79f4) bit0

name: delay_stub_src
notes: 11-word delay loop copied to RAM 0x0000 at reset; called as call 0x000000 with count in r1

name: copy_ramcode
notes: copies 0x5c3 words from flash 0x00a000 to RAM 0x0100; caller then does call mr -> 0x0100

name: ramcode_boot
notes: Runs at RAM 0x0100. Waits Power_State, sets PLL, calibrates SPIFC timing, reads flash JEDEC ID and matches table, sets quad-enable, verifies header + byte-sum checksum

name: main
notes: C main(): hardware init then loop { wait_frame(); watchdog_clear(); game_frame_update(); }

name: mem_fill_dma
notes: memset/memcpy style helper using system DMA channel 0

name: watchdog_clear
notes: writes Watchdog_Clear (0x780b)

name: clock_init
notes: PLL_Sel, TimeBase C, Timer A; loops on TimerA_UpCount vs 0x4e20 (clock calibration)

name: rtc_init
notes: RTC via indirect addr/data/request registers 0x79f0-0x79f5

name: gpio_init
notes: port direction/attribute/mux setup, key-change interrupt enables

name: audio_dac_init
notes: CHA DAC + Timer G

name: touch_init
notes: loads touch tables from 0x091167.., calls cts_hw_init

name: cts_hw_init
notes: IOF bits 8-11 as touch pads; CTS_DIV=1, CTS_Ctrl3=1, CTS_Ctrl2=2, CTS_Ctrl1=0x048e

name: touch_start_scan
notes: starts scanning from channel index 3 down to 0

name: touch_irq_flag
notes: called from irq6: sets bit 0x1000 in RAM 0x0f17

name: touch_sample_step
notes: reads CTS_CNT (0x7ac9), accumulates, drops min/max, IIR into RAM 0x0d57+ch, advances channel

name: touch_process
notes: per-scan processing of the four capacitive pads: sum of 42 samples less max and min, averaged with the previous scan; press threshold table 0x09117f (0xfc), release 0x09118f (0x6c); debounce 1 scan

name: mic_init
notes: microphone ADC setup

name: lcd_init
notes: TFT timing registers + full ST7735S init command sequence (see analysis/lcd_init_sequence.txt)

name: lcd_write_cmd
notes: TFT_MemMode_WCmd=byte; wait TFT_Status&0xf0==0; TFT_Ctrl=0xa089 (I80 CMD write)

name: lcd_write_data
notes: same with TFT_Ctrl=0xa0a9 (I80 DATA write)

name: delay
notes: busy-wait delay; argument scaled by 200

name: gpio_set_pin
notes: (pin, level): pin 6 -> IOB_Data bit 6, otherwise IOA_Data bit <pin>

name: ppu_init
notes: clears sprite RAM both banks, SControl/Blending/Fade/Palette_Control/PPU_Enable = 0

name: ppu_config
notes: sets PPU_Enable bits from 10 boolean args

name: ppu_enable
notes: PPU_Enable |= 1

name: frame_irq_enable
notes: TFT_INT_EN |= 1; irq on

name: frame_irq_clear
notes: TFT_INT_CLR = 1

name: wait_frame
notes: writes WAIT (0x780c)=0x5005 until frame counter 0x061e changes

name: set_tft_h_start
notes: TFT_H_Start = clamp(arg,0x14)+3

name: game_init
notes: palette, sprites, sound init

name: game_frame_update
notes: called once per frame from main loop

name: button_poll
notes: reads IOB_Data; button = IOB bit 2, active low -> key bit 0x02; state RAM 0x05f2 (held) 0x05f3 (pressed) 0x05f7 (released)

name: i2c_init
notes: I2C_Ctrl=0x90, I2C_Clk=0x80, I2C_Debounce=0x10, I2C_MISC=1

name: accel_read_xyz
notes: I2C device 0x30 (7-bit 0x18), registers 0x28-0x2d (LIS2DH-style OUT_X_L..OUT_Z_H)

name: card_page_program
notes: command 0x02 (0x12 with 4-byte addresses)

name: spi0_xfer_byte
notes: (byte): write SPI0_TXData 0x7942, wait for SPI0_RXStatus 0x7943 & 7, read SPI0_RXData 0x7944 into RAM 0x0d75; 0 or -1

name: spi0_write_block
notes: called in 0x100-byte steps by sub_0918d3

name: spifc_manual_cmd
notes: only non-RAM user of SPIFC_CMD

name: sound_service
notes: called from irq4 on SPU interrupt

name: scene_step
notes: Per-frame scene state machine. RAM 0x0494 current scene id, 0x0495 requested scene, 0x0496 previous scene, 0x0498 low 3 bits phase (0 init, 1 run, 2 exit). Saves on every scene exit, then checks battery status

name: scene_lookup
notes: Finds a scene id in the 200-entry table at 0x093230 (9 words per entry: id, init, update, exit, extra). See analysis/scene_table.csv

name: save_load
notes: Loads slot 0 then slot 1; if both fail, writes defaults to both

name: save_now
notes: Writes the save block to both slots

name: save_write_slot
notes: (slot): 0x127 words from RAM 0x049d plus checksum and inverted checksum (0x129 words = 594 bytes) to linear address 0x807000 + slot*0x800 (flash bytes 0xffc000 / 0xffd000)

name: save_read_slot
notes: validates one slot

name: flash_driver_load
notes: copies the flash driver into RAM 0x0100 before erase/program

name: flash_erase_sector
notes: 4 KB erase (command 0x20) through the RAM driver

name: battery_update
notes: recomputes battery status into RAM 0x05e7 (0 ok, 2 warn -> scene 9030, 3 empty -> scene 9031) from ADC channel 7, using double-precision maths and a 90-sample average

name: battery_status
notes: returns RAM 0x05e7

name: battery_adc_start
notes: ADC_Setup=0x4400, MADC_Ctrl=0x8037; channel 7 is then read every frame at 0x091dd3

name: sprite_dma
notes: SPDMA: 0x180 words from RAM 0x0b35 to sprite RAM, then waits for SPDMA_Number to read 0

name: scene_request
notes: sets RAM 0x0495

name: save_prepare
notes: (wait): TFT_Ctrl=0, optional delay loop of 1,000,000 iterations, sound and PPU off, interrupts off

name: save_finish
notes: interrupts on, PPU on, LCD command 0x2c, TFT_Ctrl=0x20cd

name: lcd_stream_off
notes: TFT_Ctrl = 0

name: lcd_stream_on
notes: LCD command 0x2c then TFT_Ctrl = 0x20cd

name: fade_start
notes: (type, level, direction, step, ?): packs a fade request into RAM 0x0b27/0x0b28; the palette is then recomputed each frame

name: key_held
notes: (mask): returns mask & RAM 0x05f2 when input is enabled (RAM 0x05f1 bit 0)

name: key_pressed
notes: (mask): same for newly pressed keys, RAM 0x05f3

name: logo_start_wait_object
notes: (0x3c, 0x80, ...): returns a handle the boot logo waits on via 0x08a246; probably starts the start-up jingle

name: wait_object_done
notes: (handle): non-zero when finished

name: spi0_init
notes: (mode): SPI0_Ctrl=0x0800, IOC bit 12 (card chip select) output high, SPI0_Ctrl=(mode&7)|0x8000, SPI0_Misc|=0x100

name: card_cs_high
notes: IOC_Buffer |= 0x1000: deselect the card

name: card_cs_low
notes: IOC_Buffer &= ~0x1000: select the card

name: spi0_write_block
notes: 8 bytes at a time, waits for SPI0_Misc 0x7945 bit 3 (receive FIFO full) and drains it

name: spi0_read_block
notes: sends zeros and collects the replies, same FIFO handling

name: card_nor_init
notes: (mode=2): spi0_init for an SPI NOR SmaCard

name: card_write_enable
notes: command 0x06

name: card_read_jedec
notes: command 0x9f, 3 bytes; capacity byte 0x19/0x1a/0x20/0x1b/0x21 selects 4-byte addressing (RAM 0x0d87)

name: card_read_status
notes: command 0x05

name: card_detect_boot
notes: IOC bit 9 input with pull-up; low = card present (unpowered card pulls the detect line down). Only called once, from main

name: card_power_on
notes: IOC bit 10 low, bits 11-14 high, then waits for bit 12 (as input) to read high

name: card_power_off
notes: SPI0 off, bit 10 high, bits 11-14 low, waits for bit 12 to read low

name: sd_card_init
notes: (retries): SD/MMC SPI-mode initialisation (CMD0 = 0x40 ...). Tried first at boot when a card is detected; success sets card type 1 (RAM 0x0491), failure means an SPI NOR SmaCard (type 2)

name: card_slot_enable
notes: (on): on = IOC bit 10 output low (card power), bit 9 input pull-down, IOC_Mux |= 0x88, RAM 0x0606 = 0, [0x78b2] = 0xe000; off = reverse

name: card_present
notes: IOC_Data bit 9 high = card present (the detect line is tied to the powered card's supply)

name: scene_ffe2_init
notes: TamaSma Card scene (DOWNLOAD / CURRENT CARD)

name: rtc_read_counter
notes: 48-bit counter from RTC registers 0x30-0x35 (32768 Hz ticks; seconds = value >> 15)

name: rtc_set_counter
notes: writes RTC registers 0x10-0x15

name: rtc_read_reg
notes: (reg): indirect read through 0x79f1/0x79f3/0x79f5

name: rtc_write_reg
notes: (reg, value): indirect write through 0x79f1/0x79f2/0x79f3

name: rtc_irq
notes: reads RTC status register 0x40; second (bit 0) or alarm (bit 1) sets RAM 0x0d56; acknowledges by writing 0xf0

name: rtc_irq_enable
notes: (mode): clears status, writes RTC interrupt enable register 0x50 = 5 or 1

name: soc_sleep
notes: IRQs off, copies a routine to RAM and runs it: [0x780d] = 0x500a stops the clocks until a wake-up event

name: delay_ms
notes: (n): n x 0xc1c iterations of watchdog_clear

name: input_events_update
notes: (list): runs the handler (table 0x095889, indexed by the type in bits 0-5) of each of up to 27 two-word event entries; bit 6 = fired

name: input_event_fired
notes: (list, type): non-zero when the event of that type fired this frame

name: touch_frame_update
notes: builds RAM 0x0609: bits 0-3 pads held (1 top-left, 2 bottom-left, 4 bottom-right, 8 top-right via table 0x095885), 4-7 previous, 8-11 pressed, 12-15 released

name: input_tap_tl
notes: event 6: top-left pad held for 12 frames. 020adc/020b68/020bf4 = events 7-9 for the other pads

name: input_swipe_left
notes: event 0x0a: press on the right half, release, left half touched within 10 frames

name: input_swipe_right
notes: event 0x0b: left half then right half

name: input_swipe_up
notes: event 0x0c: bottom half then top half. The menu uses it for the next page

name: input_swipe_down
notes: event 0x0d: top half then bottom half. Menu: previous page

name: menu_update_state
notes: main menu (scene 0x1400) state machine; page number at context+0x75

name: sleep_scene_update
notes: scene 0x9000: waits for the button to be released, powers peripherals down, arms key-change wake-up on port B bit 2 and the RTC, calls soc_sleep, then decides whether to wake fully
